title: Quarters: four equal parts
examples: How many quarters make a whole?

explain.say: 4 friends share a birthday cake. They want equal slices. Look at the board. The cake is cut into 4 equal parts. The shaded part is one quarter.
This picture shows a pie cut into equal slices. You can see the whole pie and 1 slice. Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Now 2 of the 4 parts are shaded. That is 2 quarters. 2 quarters cover half of the cake. Look at the board to check.
Here 3 parts are shaded. That is three quarters. 1 quarter is left. We write it as 3 over 4. There are 4 equal parts, and you have 3.
All 4 quarters are shaded. That is 1 whole cake. 4 quarters make 1 whole. A quarter is smaller than a half.
You can find a quarter of a group too. Share 12 strawberries between 4 people. Each person gets 3. So a quarter of 12 is 3. What is a quarter of 8?

faq.a: A quarter is one of 4 equal parts. Cut a cake into 4 equal slices, and each slice is one quarter.

faq.q: How many quarters make a whole?
faq.a: 4 quarters make one whole. Put all 4 equal slices together and you have the whole cake again.
Three quarters means 3 of the 4 equal parts. It is written 3 over 4, and only one quarter is missing.

faq.q: Is a quarter bigger or smaller than a half?
faq.a: Smaller. A half is 1 of 2 parts, but a quarter is 1 of 4 parts. Cutting into more parts makes each piece smaller. Two quarters make one half.
asks: Which is bigger, a half or a quarter?

faq.q: How do I find a quarter of 12?
faq.a: Share 12 into 4 equal groups. Each group has 3, so a quarter of 12 is 3. Or halve 12 to get 6, then halve again to get 3.

facts: 4 quarters make 1 whole, and 2 quarters make 1 half.
A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.

quiz.say: Look at a cake cut into 4 equal parts. How many quarters make 1 half?
quiz.why: A half is 2 of the 4 equal parts. So 2 quarters make 1 half.

wrong.1: 4 quarters make 1 whole cake. A half is less.
wrong.2: 1 quarter is half of a half. You need 1 more quarter.

quiz.say: Share 20 into 4 equal groups. How many are in each group?
quiz.why: 20 shared into 4 equal groups is 5 in each. So a quarter of 20 is 5.

wrong.0: 4 is the number of groups. Count how many are in each group.
wrong.2: 10 is half of 20. A quarter is smaller than a half.
